Printwell support

Step-by-step fixes for the problems people hit most with Wi‑Fi printers, plus scanning tips and help with your subscription. A person reads every email.

Quick fix: printer not found

  1. Wake the printer

    Press any button or tap the power button once, then wait about 20 seconds until the Wi‑Fi light stops blinking.

  2. Join the same Wi‑Fi

    Connect your iPhone to the same network as the printer, not a guest network and not mobile data.

  3. Allow Local Network

    In iOS Settings › Privacy & Security › Local Network, turn on Printwell.

  4. Run Fix connection

    In Printwell, open Fix connection. It compares the networks of phone and printer and shows both IP addresses.

  5. Add the printer by address

    Still missing? Tap Add printer by address and enter the IP address from the printer’s network settings screen.

Contact support

Tell us your printer model, your iPhone or iPad model and iOS version. A screenshot of Fix connection helps a lot.

Connecting to your printer

Why can’t Printwell find my printer?

Printwell lists printers that announce themselves on your Wi‑Fi. If none appears, the printer is usually asleep, on another network, or the router keeps devices apart. Run Fix connection: it checks each cause and tells you what to do.

Are my iPhone and printer on the same Wi‑Fi?

Fix connection shows both IP addresses. On a home network they usually start the same way, such as 192.168.1.x. If not, join the printer’s network in iOS Settings › Wi‑Fi.

How do I allow Local Network access?

Open iOS Settings › Privacy & Security › Local Network and turn on Printwell. Without it, iOS hides your printers from the app. It is used only to find and talk to printers and scanners.

My printer is asleep or offline

Printers sleep deeply and may drop off Wi‑Fi. Press any button, wait about 20 seconds until the Wi‑Fi light is steady, then search again. If it keeps happening, turn off auto-off or deep sleep in the printer’s settings.

Guest networks, mesh and office Wi‑Fi

Guest and many office networks use “AP isolation” (client isolation), which stops devices from seeing each other. Use the main network or turn isolation off in the router. A VPN on your iPhone can also hide local devices: pause it while printing.

How do I add a printer by its IP address?

Find the IP address in the printer’s network settings or on its network configuration page. In Printwell, tap Add printer by address and enter it, for example 192.168.1.40.

No router: can I use Wi‑Fi Direct?

Yes. Turn on Wi‑Fi Direct (Canon: Wireless Direct) in the printer’s network menu, join its “DIRECT-…” network in iOS Settings › Wi‑Fi, then return to Printwell. Meanwhile your iPhone has no internet over Wi‑Fi.

Can I print over Bluetooth or USB?

No. iPhone can’t print over a USB cable, and home and office printers print over Wi‑Fi; some use Bluetooth only during setup. Printwell prints over Wi‑Fi or Wi‑Fi Direct.

Printing

Why are ink levels missing or approximate?

Printwell shows what the printer reports. Some models report only rough levels, and refilled or third-party cartridges may report none.

How do I print from other apps?

In Files, Safari, Mail or Photos, tap Share › Print with Printwell. Not there? Scroll to the end of the list, tap Edit Actions and add it.

How do I print a passport or ID photo?

Pick a photo, then the passport or ID layout: Printwell prints it at its true size on A4 or Letter. Check your country’s required size first.

Scanning

How do I scan with my printer’s scanner?

Open Scan, pick your printer, then Glass for one page or Feeder for a stack. Turn on Two-sided if your feeder supports it. Scans are saved as PDF.

Which resolution should I choose?

300 dpi suits most documents. Use 150 dpi for small files and 600 dpi for photos or fine print.

My printer’s scanner doesn’t appear

Printwell scans with printers that offer network scanning (eSCL, also called AirScan). Some models have it switched off in their web settings, some lack it. Then scan with the camera.

Tips for camera scans

Lay the page flat on a contrasting surface in even light and hold the phone straight above it. Avoid shadows and glare.

How do I make a scan searchable?

Text recognition runs on your device and saves scans as searchable PDFs. Copy text from a page, or search all scans by any word inside them.

Subscription and billing

How do I restore my purchase?

Sign in with the same Apple Account, open Printwell and tap Restore purchases on the subscription screen.

How do I cancel my subscription or trial?

Open iOS Settings › [your name] › Subscriptions › Printwell, or tap Settings › Manage subscription in Printwell. Cancel at least 24 hours before the trial or period ends. Deleting the app doesn’t cancel.

How do I get a refund?

Apple handles payments and refunds. Request one at reportaproblem.apple.com. We can’t issue refunds ourselves.

Languages and privacy

Can I use Printwell in my language?

Printwell speaks 35 languages and follows your device. To change it only for Printwell: iOS Settings › Apps › Printwell › Language (iOS 16–17: Settings › Printwell).

Does Printwell upload my documents?

No. Files go from your iPhone straight to your printer over your own network. No account, analytics or ads. See the privacy policy.
